title: Execution: capture contract and post bound Receipt
body:
### Contract ID

exec-agent-contracts-issue-loop-001

### Revision

1

### Immutable contract reference

exec-agent-contracts-issue-loop-001@1

### Parent Goal

https://github.com/zaurakworks/agent-contracts/issues/1

### Current objective

Implement the smallest GitHub-to-local execution loop.

### In scope

- Project-local standard-library CLI and tests in this repository.
- GitHub access through the authenticated gh executable using argument arrays.

### Out of scope

- Daemons, databases, global installation, and other repositories.

### Completion criteria

- Capture is deterministic and validates the native parent.
- Receipt delivery rejects remote drift.

### Authority and read-only sources

- https://github.com/zaurakworks/agent-contracts/issues/4 — this Execution Contract.
- https://github.com/zaurakworks/agent-contracts/issues/1 — parent Goal.

### Allowed actions and writes

- Modify and push a dedicated branch in this repository.

### Forbidden actions and writes

- Merge, close Issues, or modify user-level configuration.

### Dependencies

- Parent Goal #1 remains open.

### Deliverables

- Project-local capture and Receipt CLI with offline tests.

### Stop conditions

- The authoritative Issue changes before write-back.

### Current owner action

A fresh implementation Session delivers the bounded loop without merging.
